overview: NSRCEL at IIM Bangalore is an incubation centre that empowers startups to drive technological innovation, scale globally, and create lasting impact. Established with support from Mr. N. S. Raghavan, co-founder of Infosys, NSRCEL has nurtured entrepreneurs for over two decades through sector-specific programs, mentorship, funding access, and a strong network of industry leaders. It offers incubation, acceleration, and grant support across domains like fintech, climate tech, healthcare, mobility, and social innovation.
objectives: Empower startups to drive technological innovation and scale globally
Nurture the next generation of entrepreneurs and innovation
Provide hands-on mentorship, access to funding, and a powerful network
Help founders turn ideas into thriving businesses
Support sector-specific innovation in fintech, climate, healthcare, mobility, and social impact
Enable survival, scale, and success for startups through tailored programs
Foster collaboration with industry, policy, and ecosystem partners
Create measurable impact through incubated ventures and job creation
eligibility: Eligibility varies by program but generally includes: incorporated in India, operational for at least a year, technology-based, early-revenue or pilot-ready (TRL 5+), with a working prototype or validated solution. Specific programs target student founders, women entrepreneurs, climate-tech ventures, healthcare startups, mobility innovators, and social enterprises. Some programs require DPIIT recognition, annual turnover under ₹100 crore, or focus on specific sectors like circular economy, renewable energy, or sustainable mobility.
benefits: Benefits include access to mentorship from industry experts and IIM faculty, sector-specific masterclasses, investor connects, grant opportunities (up to ₹30 lakhs in some programs), access to NSRCEL Startup Kit with partner discounts (AWS, RazorpayX, Stripe, Zoho), lab access and technical validation, policy and market access, global exposure through UNSW-led sessions, alumni network, co-incubation with partner institutes, legal and compliance support, impact measurement readiness, and participation in demo days and investor pitch events. Programs are typically free of cost and do not take equity from startups.
financial_support: Financial support varies across programs: grants of up to ₹5 lakhs for top performers in Launchpad and Campus Founders; up to ₹10 lakhs in Women Startup Program; up to ₹12.5 lakhs in Impact Orbit skilling, livelihood, and AgeTech innovations; up to ₹15 lakhs in Tech-Enabled Social Innovations; up to ₹30 lakhs in Velocity – Kotak BizLabs; and access to a ₹1.5 Cr corpus fund in Sustainable Mobility Incubation. Some programs offer milestone-based grants, paid PoCs with industry partners (e.g., Maruti Suzuki), or investor readiness support without direct grants.
application_process: 1. Visit the specific program page on NSRCEL website (e.g., https://nsrcel.org/launchpad/, https://nsrcel.org/campus-founders/). 2. Click 'Register Your Interest' or 'Apply Now' to access the application form. 3. Fill out the online application form with venture details, pitch deck, and required documents. 4. Submit the form for initial screening. 5. Undergo eligibility check and telephonic interview (if applicable). 6. Present pitch to mentor panel for evaluation. 7. Final assessment and onboarding into the program upon selection.
required_documents: Proof of prototype or validated solution (TRL 3+)
Business model and revenue model documentation
Market validation or early traction evidence
deadlines: Rolling basis — no fixed deadline. Applications are accepted year-round for most programs, with specific cohorts announced periodically.
implementing_agency: NSRCEL (National Startup Resource and Collaboration Centre for Entrepreneurship and Leadership), Indian Institute of Management Bangalore (IIMB)
contact_details: Email: nsrcel.socialmedia@iimb.ac.in | For escalations: escalations@nsrcel.iimb.ac.in | Program-specific contacts: healthcare@nsrcel.iimb.ac.in, velocity@nsrcel.iimb.ac.in, sustainabilityincubationprogram@iimb.ac.in, nsrcel.mobility@iimb.ac.in, wspqueries@iimb.ac.in, nsrcel.social@nsrcel.iimb.ac.in
caveats: Grant disbursement is milestone-based and subject to evaluation criteria
Physical events may be held in Bangalore or other cities with advance notice
Program duration may vary based on cohort and venture progress
Some programs prioritize Karnataka-based startups (e.g., Renewable Energy Incubation Centre)
Equity is not taken, but grant support is competitive and limited to select ventures
Applications may be closed for certain cohorts; interest forms are used for future notifications
Venture must demonstrate impact intent or alignment with program-specific sectors (e.g., circular economy, climate tech, social impact)
